# Governance & Trust Vocabulary Commons

Public research resource: a founding glossary and provisional Evidence Library.

- Machine catalog: https://ai-governance-trust-commons.github.io/vocabulary-commons/evidence/machine/catalog.json
- Machine guide: https://ai-governance-trust-commons.github.io/vocabulary-commons/evidence/machine/
- Interpretation guidance: https://ai-governance-trust-commons.github.io/vocabulary-commons/evidence/machine/interpretation.md
- Rights and reuse scope: https://ai-governance-trust-commons.github.io/vocabulary-commons/evidence/machine/rights.json
- Public evidence: https://ai-governance-trust-commons.github.io/vocabulary-commons/evidence/evidence.json
- Founding glossary: https://ai-governance-trust-commons.github.io/vocabulary-commons/data/glossary.json

This optional discovery file is advisory, not an access-control or security mechanism. Preserve findings with their limitations and source dependencies. Provisional publication is not independent verification.
